rows.source:
{
  "schema": "https://json.schemas.assets.semio-tech.com/framework/async/deferred-wake/schema.json#/$defs/DeferredWakeFixture",
  "capacity": {
    "maintenanceHooks": 64,
    "partitions": 64,
    "slotsPerPartition": 32,
    "totalWaiters": 2048
  },
  "dispatch": {
    "lane": "io",
    "workKind": "deferred-wake",
    "sources": [
      "job",
      "maintenance",
      "deferred-wake"
    ],
    "sourceRotation": "round-robin-within-lane",
    "wakesPerTurn": 1,
    "waiterTransfer": "move",
    "enqueueNeverCallsWaker": true,
    "catchPanics": true,
    "locksReleasedBeforeWake": [
      "maintenance-registry",
      "scheduler-lane",
      "deferred-wake-ring"
    ],
    "forbiddenEnqueueEffects": [
      "waker-callback",
      "job-allocation",
      "user-closure",
      "external-task",
      "lost-owner",
      "io"
    ]
  },
  "shutdown": {
    "native": {
      "admission": "close-then-drain-accepted-wakes",
      "workersExitAfter": "deferred-wake-ring-empty"
    },
    "cooperative": {
      "admission": "close-then-drain-accepted-wakes",
      "hasPendingWhile": "deferred-wake-ring-nonempty",
      "pump": "one-deferred-wake-per-turn-until-empty"
    },
    "afterTerminalEnqueue": "return-owner-for-exact-cell-restoration"
  },
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "cross-key-refusal",
      "parkedWaiters": 1,
      "supersededWaiters": 0,
      "transferredWaiters": 1,
      "restoredWaiters": 0,
      "enqueuePhase": "open",
      "requestMayHoldExternalLock": true,
      "expected": {
        "inlineWakes": 0,
        "drainedWakes": 1,
        "jobs": 0,
        "lostOwners": 0,
        "io": 0,
        "externalTasks": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "retry-supersedes-self",
      "parkedWaiters": 2,
      "supersededWaiters": 1,
      "transferredWaiters": 1,
      "restoredWaiters": 0,
      "enqueuePhase": "open",
      "requestMayHoldExternalLock": true,
      "expected": {
        "inlineWakes": 0,
        "drainedWakes": 1,
        "jobs": 0,
        "lostOwners": 0,
        "io": 0,
        "externalTasks": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance-capacity-independent",
      "parkedWaiters": 1,
      "supersededWaiters": 0,
      "transferredWaiters": 1,
      "restoredWaiters": 0,
      "enqueuePhase": "maintenance-full",
      "requestMayHoldExternalLock": true,
      "expected": {
        "inlineWakes": 0,
        "drainedWakes": 1,
        "jobs": 0,
        "lostOwners": 0,
        "io": 0,
        "externalTasks": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "shutdown-drains-accepted",
      "parkedWaiters": 2048,
      "supersededWaiters": 0,
      "transferredWaiters": 2048,
      "restoredWaiters": 0,
      "enqueuePhase": "before-shutdown",
      "requestMayHoldExternalLock": true,
      "expected": {
        "inlineWakes": 0,
        "drainedWakes": 2048,
        "jobs": 0,
        "lostOwners": 0,
        "io": 0,
        "externalTasks": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "terminal-shutdown-restores-owner",
      "parkedWaiters": 1,
      "supersededWaiters": 0,
      "transferredWaiters": 0,
      "restoredWaiters": 1,
      "enqueuePhase": "after-terminal-shutdown",
      "requestMayHoldExternalLock": true,
      "expected": {
        "inlineWakes": 0,
        "drainedWakes": 0,
        "jobs": 0,
        "lostOwners": 0,
        "io": 0,
        "externalTasks": 0
      }
    }
  ],
  "runtimeMarkers": {
    "async": [
      "WorkerDeferredWakeTicket",
      "WorkerDeferredWakeRegistry",
      "PoolWork::DeferredWake",
      "WORKER_DEFERRED_WAKE_PARTITIONS",
      "WORKER_DEFERRED_WAKES_PER_PARTITION"
    ]
  }
}
